text: Somewhere in the code there is a constant, and the constant wins, quietly.

text: OpenTofu is the tool that describes the installation as code.

text: Its catalogue holds a value for each policy in the requirements, and the default texts for consent, terms and notifications, in four languages.

text: Two kinds of values sit in that configuration.

text: Policies are settings of the bank: code lifetimes, attempt limits and waiting times.

text: Months later, Malika, a security administrator of the bank, wants a shorter lifetime for one-time codes.

text: The proposal shows the current value, the new value and her reason.

text: A second security administrator must approve it, and Malika cannot approve her own proposal.

text: This is maker-checker: one person makes a change, and a different person with the same role checks it.
